title: Contrapunctus X

captions.text: ☞ Subject I in the alto: a turn round D, then a run upwards.
☞ The answer in the tenor, as the alto's run reaches its top.
☞ Subject I inverted in the bass.
☞ Subject I inverted in the soprano: all four voices are in.
☞ Subject II in the soprano: the dotted subject of Contrapunctus V.
☞ Stretto: subject II in the alto, a bar behind the soprano.
☞ Subject II in the alto, with subject I in the tenor.
☞ Subject II in soprano and alto, a sixth apart; subject I in the bass.
☞ Subject I in alto and soprano together, a third apart.
☞ Subject I in tenor and bass a third apart, II in the soprano.
☞ The last entries: subject I in alto and tenor together, a third apart.

listenFor: a new subject and the dotted subject of V, combined and doubled in tenths
